children: According to Wallstreetcn, Omani Foreign Minister Badr said at the 81st United Nations General Assembly on the 26th that Oman will continue to work to safeguard navigation security in the Strait of Hormuz, and he called on all parties to cooperate with Oman to ensure passage through the strait in accordance with international law.

title: Oman Says It Will Continue to Safeguard Navigation Security in the Strait of Hormuz
